leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a standardized response envelope function that accepts data, status, and message parameters
Initialize a Node.js project with necessary dependencies for API development
Implement middleware to wrap API responses using the envelope function
Configure error handling to return consistent error response envelopes
Integrate the response standardizer into an existing Express.js route structure
Manipulate response objects to include metadata like timestamps and request IDs
Apply the envelope standardizer across multiple API endpoints to ensure uniformity
